body:
SCOUT SOURCE CHECK — the hold identifies a real authority gap, and the successor falsifier should target identity rather than only display labels.

Current source distinguishes structural proof from construction authority. RecallGraphStatus.Checked is documented as structural and text-at-span checking, and RecallGraph.validated checks atlas/transcript coherence, ordinals, spans and relation endpoints (recall/graph.scala:7-22, 71ff). HsmmResult.validated derives recallChecksum from the selected checked graph and binds rows exactly to that graph's units (align/hsmm.scala:242ff); AlignWire.recallChecksum commits to the selected unit content (align/wire.scala:228ff). Neither value records whether that graph came from heuristic segmentation, resolved alternatives or adjudication. Therefore identical selected graph bytes can legitimately yield identical current recallChecksum and P/F while their scientific authority differs.

Narrow successor courts should establish three relations without pre-approving public names:

1. Hold transcript, selected RecallGraph, source view, nomination bundle, model configuration, P/F, costs and rendering bytes fixed. Replace an admitted construction record with heuristic-only or missing authority. Publication-grade nomination/visualization identity must change or refuse; unchanged numbers cannot preserve the authority claim.

2. The selected-alternative identity must be derived by proving membership in the exact retained alternative set under the bound policy and receipt. A caller-supplied selection label beside the graph would recreate the defect.

3. Every sensitivity member must bind its own construction identity and complete recall/result tuple. A split or merge changes the recall-unit axis, so separate P/F matrices are necessary but not sufficient: each result family needs its own unit/row basis. Any cross-family aggregate still needs the chief-named common base measure and calibration.

This supports the hold as a content restriction. It is not a CODE RED disposition, public-vocabulary proposal, successor claim, authorization or landing action.
